# Allegro 4.0.3: headers and export table

Allegro 4.0.3 files needed to compile the game with VC6 and link it against `alleg40.dll`. The rest of the archive (library sources, docs, examples) is not included here. Licence: *gift-ware*, see `readme.txt`.

## Provenance

- Archive: `all403.zip`, GitHub release `liballeg/allegro5`, tag `v4-0-3`. It is not listed on liballeg.org/old.html.
- SHA-256 of the archive: `8bff49989e3c031ef30e5dcdf5be0ff6d2b4cd980f880b618519b6b3ab7d8f9c`.
- Working copy outside the repository: `captures/allegro-4.0.3/` (archive and full extraction, unmodified).
- Files copied from the archive byte for byte, CRLF line endings included (`.gitattributes`: `-text`):
  - `include/`: the whole directory;
  - `lib/msvc/allegro.def`: the 1,292 exports with their ordinals;
  - `readme.txt` (licence) and `AUTHORS`.
- Match with the game: `notes/allegro.md`. The ordinals in the `.def` are identical to those of `alleg40.dll`. The inline code observed in the exes is identical to that of these headers.

## Only modification: `include/allegro/platform/alplatf.h`

The archive ships this file configured for DJGPP (`#define ALLEGRO_DJGPP`, generated by `fix.sh`). It is replaced by what `fix.bat msvc` would write, byte for byte, trailing spaces included:

```c
/* generated by fix.bat */
#define ALLEGRO_MSVC
```

No `ALLEGRO_NO_ASM` nor `ALLEGRO_USE_C`: the inline asm of `al386vc.h` (`fixmul`, `fixdiv`...) is the game's (`CLAUDE.md`, section "Next phase").

## Import library

`alleg40.lib` is not versioned (`*.lib` in `.gitignore`). It is generated with VC6's `lib`:

```
LIB /NOLOGO /DEF:3rdparty\allegro-4.0.3\lib\msvc\allegro.def /MACHINE:IX86 /NAME:alleg40.dll /OUT:build\alleg40.lib
```

[verified] It imports by ordinal, like the game's exes (`notes/toolchain-vc6.md` §6).
